patches.find: With our configuration ($|\mathcal{A}|=42$, $K \approx 2.4$, $E_S=3$), the NAS stage requires only $\sim$6$\times$ the computation of training a single architecture, making it highly efficient compared to exhaustive search.
patches.replace: With our configuration ($|\mathcal{A}|=42$, $K \approx 2.4$, $E_S=3$), the NAS stage consists of 100 trials of three epochs each, which keeps the search cheap relative to evaluating the full space at the final training budget.
patches.note: U4: the "~6x" multiplier had no artefact and is dimensionally ambiguous (0.6x by epoch count, 6x only by wall clock). Replaced with the audited trial count.
